title: Fujifilm to boost tape production 5x as AI fuels archiving demand
gist: Fujifilm will invest about 10 billion yen (~$63 million) over fiscal 2026-2028 to raise LTO magnetic tape production capacity fivefold versus FY2025 levels at its Kanagawa Factory Odawara site, citing generative-AI-driven data growth. Cloud and data center operators are expanding tape use for low-cost bulk storage and air-gapped ransomware protection.

insights.claim: Fujifilm will invest roughly 10 billion yen (about $63 million) to increase its magnetic tape production capacity fivefold, measured against fiscal year 2025 production levels.
insights.speaker: Nick Indge
insights.so_what: A storage-media supplier is betting on a multi-year step-up in archival tape demand.
insights.quote: Fujifilm said it will invest roughly 10 billion yen (about $63 million) to increase its production capacity fivefold

insights.speaker: Nick Indge
insights.so_what: The capacity ramp is phased over three fiscal years, so supply growth arrives gradually.
